news.title: Locking in the rate or staying flexible? Mortgage refinancing around an interest rate shock
news.description: This paper examines UK mortgage refinancing around the 23 September 2022 mini-budget interest rate shock, exploiting predetermined expiry dates of discounted two and five year fixed-rate mortgages.
